system.description: An intact piece of a wyvern's natural scaly hide. Very valuable and produces the finest armor.
Target is Restrained for 1 turn on a successful hit. Cannot make Extra Attacks.
The Wyvern spends its Action to inhale deeply, preparing its vicious fire breath to be unleashed next phase. It loses this preparation if it becomes Stance Broken.

customData.name: Charge: Breath
customData.description: This unit is preparing to launch a powerful breath attack!

system.description:
The wyvern breathes a forward cone of drakefire. Affected units must succeed an Agi saving throw (DC 15), or suffer 3d8 + Tqn Fire damage and 2 Brk. On a successful save, units are only dealt 1d8 + Tqn Fire damage and no Brk damage. 

Affected squares leave behind Fire Tiles for 1 round.
